title: Statement of Account Calculation: Amount of a Late-Delivery Refund (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
A late order's speed fee is refunded at the plan's late-delivery refund percentage of that speed fee, rounded to the cent, under Delivery & Pickup Services.

## Inputs

- **The late order.** The late order concerned is the one whose delivery was most recently completed on the plan.
- **Its speed fee.** For an express order the speed fee is its express fee, for a same-day order its same-day fee; the amount is the fee of that kind booked against the late order on the plan's charge ledger. An order of any other speed has no speed fee.
- **The late-delivery refund percentage.** The plan's late refund percentage on the Delivery & Pickup Services service levels table.

## The amount

The late-delivery refund is the speed fee taken at the late-delivery refund percentage, never more than the speed fee itself, stated to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical late orders)

| Plan | Late order's speed | Speed fee booked on the order | Late refund percentage | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | same-day | $7.99 | 100 | $7.99 |
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | express | $12.99 | 100 | $12.99 |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | express | $6.99 | 100 | $6.99 |

Where two orders on the plan were delivered late in the same week, the order worked out is the one whose delivery was completed most recently.
